content: रूक्ष {%a.%} (written as रुक्ष also)¦ .²1 Rough, harsh, not smooth or soft (as touch, sound <ab>&c.</ab>); पुंस्कोकिलगिरं श्रुत्वा रूक्षा ध्वाङ्क्षस्य वागिव <ls>Mb. 1. 2. 384</ls>; रूक्षस्वरं वाशति वायसोऽयम् <ls>Mk. 9. 10</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 17</ls>. .²2 Astringent (taste). .²3 Rough, uneven, difficult, austere. .²4 Sullied, soiled, dirtied; रथतुरगरजोभिस्तस्य रूक्षालकाग्रा <ls>R. 7. 70</ls>; <ls>Mu. 4. 5</ls>. .²5 Cruel, unkind, harsh; नितान्तरूक्षाभिनिवेशमीशम् <ls>R. 14. 43</ls>; संरम्भरूक्षमिव सुन्दरि यद् यदासीत् <ls>V. 3. 20</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 32</ls>; <ls>Pt. 4. 91</ls>. .²6 Arid, parched up, dry, dreary; स्निग्धश्यामाः क्वचिदपरतो भीषणाभोगरूक्षाः <ls>U. 2. 14</ls>. .²7 Not oily (as food); <ls>Bg. 17. 9</ls>. (रूक्षीकृ means ‘to make rough’, ‘soil’, ‘besmear’). .{@-क्षः@} .²1 A tree. .²2 Harshness, hardness. .{@-क्षा@} .²1 Croton Polyandrum (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>दन्ती</ns>). .²2 Honey sugar. .{@-क्षम्@} .²1 The thick part of curds. .²2 A good kind of iron. .²3 Black pepper.
